about_short_description.short_description: Stablecoin API for global payments — One API. Multiple payment rails.

product.name: BlindPay Payment API
product.description: An API that enables developers to integrate digital dollars and multiple payment rails into their payment flows for instant global transfers and settlements.

product.name: KYC/KYB Identity Verification Service
product.description: A service for verifying individual and business identities to meet regulatory compliance requirements during onboarding.

product.name: Bank Account Management
product.description: A service to add and manage various types of bank accounts across multiple countries and payment systems for payouts and payins.

product.name: Payouts and Settlements
product.description: A service to request quotes and execute payouts in digital dollars or fiat currencies with automatic currency consolidation and instant settlements.

product.name: Blockchain Wallet Integration
product.description: A service to create and manage blockchain wallets for digital dollar transactions, including message signing and wallet custody.

product.name: Payins Service
product.description: A service to request quotes and execute incoming payments (payins) in digital dollars via blockchain wallets.
